decision.title: View types in their own header
decision.summary: sxml_byte_view and sxml_memory_view live in their own header include/sxml/view.h to avoid an include cycle between status.h and memory.h, while the view functions stay in memory.h.

body.p: (task 0.5). sxml_byte_view and sxml_memory_view live in include/sxml/view.h, with SXML_BYTE_VIEW_INITIALIZER (brace form, for static tables) and SXML_BYTE_VIEW_FROM_LITERAL (compound literal). status.h needs byte views and memory.h needs sxml_status, so the views cannot live in either without a cycle. memory.h includes view.h, so "memory.h provides the views" still holds. The view functions (sxml_byte_view_equals, sxml_memory_view_slice, ...) are in memory.h. The header sxml/string.h shares its file name with <string.h>; it is only ever included as "sxml/string.h" and include/sxml/ is never put on an include path itself.
